title: Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) — therapeutic class study CS-3514/R-10006
description: This generated study (CS-3514/R-10006, compiled 2016) surveys 124 published references on Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) for a therapeutic class study. The established facts remain: irreversibly block the stomach’s proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase), strongly reducing acid secretion Example drugs covered include omeprazole and esomeprazole; therapeutic uses surveyed include GERD and ulcers. As a Signature-generated study record, the survey scenario is illustrative; the class facts come from published pharmacology. Educational reference only; not medical advice. No dosage information is stored in this database.
